description: Tests three hard scenarios: (1) multi-update collision — same goal updated multiple times, most recent value must win; (2) goal target revision — HbA1c target changes mid-trace, old target must not be reported as current; (3) allergy cross-reference — user asks about ibuprofen for a new symptom, system must surface the ibuprofen allergy from memory without requiring user to remind it.
